name: Wildflower Farms Hotel, Auberge Collection
positioning: A working-farm retreat of free-standing cabins on 140 acres in Gardiner, New York, officially called Wildflower Farms, Auberge Collection
best_for: Couples and families who want a countryside base with farm experiences
Guests who like private cabins with hot tubs and fireplaces

facts.text: The hotel is set on 140 acres in Gardiner, New York.
The accommodations are free-standing cabins with views of the Shawangunk Ridge.
Cabins and cottages have floor-to-ceiling windows with bedside views of the wildflower meadows and private patios with lounge areas.
The Two-Bedroom Connecting Cottages are described as suited to families, multigenerational travel or small groups.
The Great Porch is an open-air venue serving coffee and pastries in the morning and cocktails before dinner.
Guests can join complimentary 45-minute wellness classes offered daily.
Guests can reserve the tennis and pickleball courts and use complimentary balls and rackets.
There is a natural playground with a small zipline and a network of trails through the woods and meadows.
The hotel can accommodate up to two dogs for a one-time pet fee.

highlights.text: Wildflower Farms is a working farm.
The Ridge Suites include indoor and outdoor fireplaces and a cedar hot tub.
Clay serves breakfast, lunch and dinner with a rustic New American menu built on seasonal vegetables grown locally and onsite.
An overnight stay includes Mercedes-Benz vehicles for local exploration.
The 140-acre property was a former tree nursery, and a dairy farm before that.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a kids' club.
Dew Bar, the poolside bar, opens seasonally from Memorial Day to September 30th, weather permitting.
The hotel is reached along a long dirt road.
